tools.name: exec_command
tools.description: Execute a Bash command in the Kali guest with optional stdin, cwd, environment and bounded output.

tools.name: create_terminal
tools.description: Create an interactive Bash session attached to a Unix PTY in the Kali guest.

tools.name: send_terminal_input
tools.description: Write text or control characters to a persistent PTY.

tools.name: read_terminal_output
tools.description: Read bounded output from a persistent PTY.

tools.name: close_terminal
tools.description: Terminate and reap a persistent PTY session.

tools.name: resize_terminal
tools.description: Set PTY rows and columns and signal the foreground terminal process.

tools.name: observe_screen
tools.description: Capture the Kali desktop PNG, resolution and SHA-256.

tools.name: computer_input
tools.description: Apply bounded generic mouse and keyboard events to the Kali desktop.

tools.name: import_file
tools.description: Import an artifact from the attempt's controller-side store into a guest path.

tools.name: export_file
tools.description: Export a bounded guest file to the controller-side store and return its artifact ID.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Navigate a browser page to an HTTP(S) URL.

tools.name: new_page
tools.description: Open a new browser tab, optionally at a URL.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List browser tabs and the active tab.

tools.name: close_page
tools.description: Close the selected browser tab.

tools.name: switch_page
tools.description: Activate a browser tab.

tools.name: go_back
tools.description: Navigate backward in a browser tab.

tools.name: go_forward
tools.description: Navigate forward in a browser tab.

tools.name: reload
tools.description: Reload a browser tab.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click a DOM element selected by CSS.

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Fill a DOM form element with text.

tools.name: press
tools.description: Press a key on a DOM element.

tools.name: hover
tools.description: Hover over a DOM element.

tools.name: drag
tools.description: Drag one DOM element onto another.

tools.name: select_option
tools.description: Select option values in a DOM select element.

tools.name: query_selector
tools.description: Query matching DOM elements and bounded text.

tools.name: inspect_dom
tools.description: Inspect bounded DOM nodes for a CSS selector.

tools.name: get_html
tools.description: Return bounded page or element HTML.

tools.name: get_attribute
tools.description: Read an attribute of a DOM element.

tools.name: evaluate_javascript
tools.description: Evaluate JavaScript in the selected browser page.

tools.name: get_cookies
tools.description: Read browser cookies.

tools.name: set_cookie
tools.description: Set a browser cookie.

tools.name: clear_cookies
tools.description: Clear browser cookies.

tools.name: get_console_logs
tools.description: Read bounded browser console events.

tools.name: get_network_logs
tools.description: Read bounded browser request and response events.

tools.name: get_request_details
tools.description: Read headers and method for a captured browser request.

tools.name: get_response_body
tools.description: Read a bounded captured browser response body.

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Select an existing Kali file for a browser file input.

tools.name: download_file
tools.description: Download a clicked browser link into the Kali Downloads directory.
